allocationOverhead.source: Conservative forecast allowance of $0.15 per GiB of verified final release files for one AWS Ohio internet upload; not an observed invoice. Compute, up to 1 TiB gp3 and one IPv4 address are covered by the separate $4/allocation-hour allowance. https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/

rate.source: Conservative allocation allowance: AWS Ohio Linux OnDemand g7e.2xlarge is $3.36312/hour (AWS price list published 2026-09-10); remainder allows up to 1 TiB gp3 root storage and one public IPv4 address. Transfer costs require separate evidence. https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonEC2/current/us-east-2/index.json

protocol.cachePolicy: Pre-read pinned inputs before each independent process; fresh per-point compiler caches; reset weights, optimizer, scheduler and RNG from the same base checkpoint.

checkpoint.scope: model, optimizer, scheduler and RNG state; retain one checkpoint

dataset.selection: First 32 DROID episodes, both model cameras, converted with the pinned source converter; the estimate concerns this DROID fine-tuning scenario.

evaluation.scope: No periodic policy evaluation in this fine-tuning scenario

hardware.accelerator: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
